reasoning_summary: Execute a safe partial plan: pick holder_0 from above and lift it horizontally, then hold. Full placement cannot be certified with the supplied grasp geometry: a TCP aligned with the disc centre would need y=-3.614, exceeding the permitted TCP insertion limit y=-3.584 by 0.030 m. Also, changing a rigid top grasp to tool_down=false would tilt the disc rather than keep it horizontal. Completing insertion requires a validated horizontal-tool grasp transform or regrasp that preserves disc orientation and supplies sufficient forward offset. No unverified offset or orientation change is assumed.
